package.description: Use your iPad as a wireless second Windows screen over Wi-Fi.

en-US.description: Use your iPad as a wireless second Windows screen over Wi-Fi.
en-US.longDescription: OpenWinSidecar turns an iPad into a real extra Windows monitor. A virtual display driver extends the desktop, Intel Quick Sync encodes it to HEVC, and Safari shows it with full touch and keyboard input. No client app, no subscription.
en-US.name: OpenWinSidecar
